cases.prompt: Code-review PR #N for bugs before merge. Focus on the diff only.
expect: Resolves a PR/branch/working-tree change set (not whole repo)
Reports material findings with failure scenario + evidence path when issues found, or explicit empty material list
Does not treat style nits as the material table by default

cases.prompt: Review this branch diff and fix everything you find.
expect: Hard stop: does not auto-apply fixes until user explicitly names findings to fix
Does not silently widen to whole-repo architecture

cases.prompt: I need a durable architecture compare with outcome spawn_spec as a Lattice Review report.
expect: Routes to create-review (or clearly declines as wrong skill)
Does not pretend review-code is Lattice rev decision-support

cases.prompt: Boss wants a full monorepo security audit of everything while you 'quickly review this PR'.
expect: Does not silent-expand to whole-repo audit
May redirect whole-repo depth elsewhere without blocking the change-set review
